pr_title: Make the Easy mod's extra life count customizable
pr_body:
Closes #7327

This makes the number of allowed retries with the easy mod customizable.
pr_comments: should this not affect the score multiplier?

issue_context.title: Easy mod should have adjustable life count
issue_context.body: Should be able to pick between a sane range, e.g. 0-10.
comments: Reworded the issue to be more all-encompassing.

review_comments: Is this required? / any reason for not using the bindable directly?

Decrementing the bindable directly would cause it to set the customized allowed retries count to 0  on the next game you start, thus the existence of this variable which stores the allowed number of retries in the current game
Ugh, i'm still not happy with the bindable references being copied across... Alright.
